summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I filed a Form 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary GPIF I Funding entered on September 30, 2026 into a third amended and restated side letter to its Bank of America revolving credit and security facility. The side letter revises the minimum utilization threshold used to calculate the unused commitment fee through December 31, 2026. Bank of America serves as administrative agent and sole lender, with Computershare as collateral custodian. No board recommendation, pricing, ownership change, or deal terms are implicated; this is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle.
